福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・大臺南

七股鹽山與黑面琵鷺Qigu Salt Mountain & Black-faced Spoonbills

歡迎來到台南海邊的七股，這裡有一座鹽做的山，還有地球上最稀有的鳥之一。幾百年來，這片海岸靠曬鹽為生：海水進、太陽曬、鹽出來。2002 年鹽場關閉，最後一座大鹽堆被留下來，成為鹽業的紀念碑。每年秋天，黑面琵鷺從朝鮮半島海岸飛約兩千公里，來到曾文溪口。全球超過一半的黑面琵鷺，在台灣過冬。帶上望遠鏡、輕聲細語，七股探險開始！

Welcome to Qigu, on Tainan's coast, home of a mountain made of salt and one of the rarest birds on Earth. For centuries this coast made salt: sea water in, sunshine on, salt out. In 2002 the salt works closed, and the last great stockpile was kept as the industry's own monument. Every autumn, black-faced spoonbills fly about two thousand kilometers from the Korean coast to the Zengwen River mouth. More than half of the world's black-faced spoonbills spend the winter in Taiwan. Bring your telescope, keep your voice down, and let's start exploring Qigu!

一分鐘看懂

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

七股有兩個招牌：鹽場最後留下的一座鹽山，見證幾百年的曬鹽產業；每年秋冬，全球超過一半的黑面琵鷺來到曾文溪口過冬。

Qigu has two great sights: a mountain of salt, the last pile from centuries of salt-making, and every winter more than half of the world's black-faced spoonbills, which come to the Zengwen River mouth.

  1. 數百年來 For centuries這片海岸靠曬鹽為生。This coast lives on sea salt.
  2. 1980 年代末 Late 1980s全球黑面琵鷺一度只剩幾百隻。Only a few hundred black-faced spoonbills are left in the world.
  3. 2002鹽場關閉，最後一座大鹽堆成為鹽山。The salt works close, and the last great pile becomes Salt Mountain.
  4. 每年 Every year九月底到隔年春天，是黑面琵鷺的季節。Late September to spring is spoonbill season.

認識景點

About the place

鹽山：七股鹽山整座都是鹽，而且可以爬上去。 鹽田：利用陽光把海水蒸發。 海水：首先，海水流進鹽田。 蒸發：太陽把水分蒸發，留下鹽。

salt mountain: The Qigu Salt Mountain is made entirely of salt, and you can climb it. salt field: Salt fields use sunshine to evaporate sea water. sea water: First, sea water flows into the salt fields. evaporate: The sun evaporates the water and leaves the salt behind.

滷水：水分越曬越少，變成很鹹的滷水。 鹽結晶：是白色的，像小小的立方體。 耙子：工人用耙子把鹽結晶耙成一小堆一小堆。 庫存堆：鹽山是鹽場最後一座大庫存堆。

brine: As the water dries, it becomes salty brine. salt crystal: Salt crystals are white and shaped like little cubes. rake: Workers rake the salt crystals into little piles. stockpile: The salt mountain is the last great stockpile of the salt works.

出口貨：鹽是老台南四大出口貨之一，另外是糖、米和樟腦。 鹹冰棒：一小撮鹽會讓甜更甜，這是化學。 山頂：從山頂可以看到棋盤般的舊鹽田。 黑面琵鷺：牠有白色的身體、黑色的臉，嘴巴像一支湯匙。

export: Salt was one of old Tainan's four great exports, with sugar, rice and camphor. salt popsicle: A pinch of salt makes sweetness sweeter. That is chemistry. summit: From the summit, you can see the checkerboard of old salt fields. black-faced spoonbill: It has a white body, a black face, and a bill shaped like a spoon.

瀕危的：1980 年代末，全球的黑面琵鷺一度只剩幾百隻。 遷徙：黑面琵鷺每年秋天從朝鮮半島海岸往南遷徙。 河口：牠們在曾文溪口過冬。 濕地：每年九月底到隔年春天，七股濕地就是琵鷺總部。

endangered: In the late 1980s, only a few hundred spoonbills were left in the world. migrate: Spoonbills migrate south from the Korean coast every autumn. estuary: They winter at the estuary of the Zengwen River. wetland: The Qigu wetlands become spoonbill headquarters from late September to spring.

招潮蟹：在退潮的泥灘上，揮動牠那一隻超大的螯。 望遠鏡：志工會很樂意幫你把望遠鏡對準鳥。 賞鳥亭：在賞鳥亭安靜觀察，請不要飛空拍機。 小白鷺：夏天來的朋友可以先看白鷺鷥，冬天再來。

fiddler crab: Fiddler crabs wave their one giant claw on the mudflats at low tide. telescope: Volunteers will happily aim the telescope for you. bird hide: Watch quietly from the bird hide. No drones, please. little egret: Summer visitors can enjoy the egrets and plan a winter return.

蒼鷺：是一種嘴巴黃色的灰色大鳥。 高蹺鴴：有一雙很長的粉紅色腳。 反嘴鴴：有一支往上翹的細長嘴。

grey heron: The grey heron is a big grey bird with a yellow bill. black-winged stilt: The black-winged stilt has very long pink legs. pied avocet: The pied avocet has a thin bill that curves upward.

實景照片

Photos on site

淺灘上的黑面琵鷺 Spoonbills in the shallows

一群黑面琵鷺站在曾文溪口的淺水裡休息。牠們白天大多把扁扁的長嘴插進背上的羽毛裡睡覺，傍晚以後才成群出去覓食，用像飯匙一樣的嘴在水裡左右掃動捉魚蝦。每年九月底到隔年春天，是在七股看牠們的季節；請待在賞鳥亭或堤岸上，用望遠鏡觀察，別走近驚擾牠們。

A flock of black-faced spoonbills rests in the shallow water near the Zengwen River mouth. During the day they mostly sleep with their flat bills tucked into their back feathers. In the evening they head out together to feed, sweeping their spoon-shaped bills from side to side to catch fish and shrimp. Late September to spring is the season to see them at Qigu. Please watch from the bird hides or the embankment with binoculars, and do not walk close.

鹽雕北極熊 Polar bears made of salt

七股鹽山園區裡有鹽雕展示，這些雪白的雕像都是用鹽做的。兩隻北極熊站在冰山前，背後畫著綠色和紫色的極光，彷彿走進北極。

The Qigu Salt Mountain park has a salt sculpture show, and these snow-white figures are all made of salt. Two polar bears stand before an iceberg, with green and purple northern lights painted behind them, as if you had walked into the Arctic.

飛過極光的鹽雕鳥群 Salt birds in flight

一群用鹽雕成的鳥用細線吊在半空中，排成隊伍飛過極光；下面的鹽雕雪原上，還刻著一位長髮少女和展翅的大鳥。

A flock of salt birds hangs from thin threads, flying in a line across the northern lights. On the salt snowfield below are a long-haired girl and a great bird with spread wings.

鹽雕老鷹 A salt eagle

近看一隻展開雙翼的老鷹，一根根羽毛都清楚刻了出來。鹽比石頭軟，又怕潮濕，雕刻時要格外小心。

Up close, an eagle spreads its wings, with every feather carved in detail. Salt is softer than stone and does not like damp air, so carving it takes great care.

鹽雕老國王 A king carved in salt

一位戴著王冠、留著長鬍子的老國王，手握長矛斜靠在雪地上，身後披風翻飛。整件作品都用鹽雕成，在極光背景前更顯得雪白。

An old king with a crown and a long beard leans back on the snow, gripping a spear as his cape flies behind him. The whole piece is carved from salt and looks even whiter against the northern lights.
